title: 音響工学
subtitle: Acoustical Engineering
teachers:
AOKI Shigeaki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In our daily life, all kinds of sounds are surrounded. The sounds are essential to our lives. In this course, mathematically expression of the physical characteristics of sound waves and analysis of phenomena are learned. Also applied techniques of sound and audio, behavior of sounds related to room acoustics and hearing in daily life, and so on are learned.
advice:
1 Physical phenomenon of sound
   Characteristics of sound wave, vibration of string, vibration of air column
2 Physical quantity of sound
   Sound velocity, sound intensity, sound pressure level, noise level, distance attenuation,
absorption/reflection/refraction/transmission, diffraction
3 Audio application
   CD player, sound editing, sound processing
4 Room acoustics
   Basic concept, sound ray method, impulse response, reverberation time, room sound field, acoustic design
5 Hearing
  Hearing mechanism, sound perception, three elements of sound, pitch perception, direction perception
This course are conducted by following the syllabus, but since progress is adjusted while confirming the degree of understanding from the results of students' attitudes in the class, question situations, quizzes, etc., the course schedule and learning contents may be changed.
This course is more specialized in the field of acoustic in the "Introduction to Acoustics and Imaging", which has already been offered. It will also lead to the understanding of the "Acoustic and Imaging Systems" and "Optical Information Engineering" which will be offered in the next semester.
requiredKnowledge:
This course is related to the contents of "Electric Circuits", "Electronic Circuits", "Electromagnetics" and "Introduction to Acoustics and Imaging", and please review the basic items you have learned in those courses.
Some of the knowledge acquired in the above department are used. If you find it difficult to understand during the course and do not understand even if you review it, do not leave it in an unknown state, and be sure to 1) check multiple reference books, 2) ask the professor in the course, 3) utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center and the SL consultation desk, you are required to work actively

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain the physical phenomena of sound.v
Be able to use physical quantities of sound and to express physical properties of sound and analyze phenomena.
Be able to understand and explain the application of audio.
Be able to understand the behavior of sounds related to room acoustics and to apply them in engineering.
Be able to understand the behavior of sounds related to hearing and to apply them in engineering.
